cues.en: is that we wanted to make sure that citizens back in Africa

cues.zh: 能听到这样一个事实：这些政策
cues.en: should hear about the fact that such policies

cues.zh: 在英国已经彻底失败。
cues.en: have been a complete failure here in the UK.

cues.zh: 我们知道，这些产品并没有向非洲国家推销
cues.en: We know that these products are not marketed to African countries

cues.zh: 以符合它们自身最大利益的方式。
cues.en: in their own best interest.

cues.zh: 唯一的动机是把金融服务的触角扩展到新市场。
cues.en: The only motivation is to spread the reach of financial services into new markets.

cues.zh: 这一切都是在为伦敦金融城的利益而推动。
cues.en: It is all being promoted in the interests of the City of London.

cues.zh: 你看到的基本上是第二种形式的殖民。
cues.en: What you are seeing is basically a second form of colonisation.

cues.zh: 一开始是占领和资源开采
cues.en: You have had initially occupation and resource extraction

cues.zh: 通过这一过程，像英国这样的国家，
cues.en: and through that process countries like Britain,

cues.zh: 它们曾拥有庞大的离岸帝国
cues.en: which have had a large offshore empire

cues.zh: 建立了重要的网络，而现在这些网络
cues.en: have developed significant networks, and now those networks

cues.zh: 正被用来推广和利用金融服务。
cues.en: are being used to promote and exploit financial services.

cues.zh: 伦敦金融城曾是大英帝国跳动的金融心脏。
cues.en: The City of London was the beating financial heart of the British Empire.

cues.zh: 随着大英帝国衰落，
cues.en: Britain's Empire declined,

cues.zh: 伦敦金融城转型
cues.en: the City transformed itself

cues.zh: 从一个运营帝国金融机器的枢纽
cues.en: from a hub operating the financial machinery of Empire

cues.zh: 转变为全球金融中心。
cues.en: into a global financial centre.

cues.zh: 昔日帝国无足轻重的前哨
cues.en: Former insignificant outposts of Empire

cues.zh: 成了离岸保密辖区蛛网的基础
cues.en: became the basis for a spider's web of offshore secrecy jurisdictions

cues.zh: 这张网攫取全球财富
cues.en: that captured wealth from across the globe

cues.zh: 再将其输送至伦敦金融城。
cues.en: and funnelled it to the City of London.

cues.zh: 如今，25%的国际金融活动在英国领土上进行。
cues.en: Today, 25% of international finance is conducted on British territory.

cues.zh: 全球近半数的保密辖区
cues.en: Almost half of the world's secrecy jurisdictions

cues.zh: 都处于英国的保护之下，
cues.en: are under British protection,

cues.zh: 多达一半的离岸财富可能藏在英国的离岸避风港中。
cues.en: up to half of offshore wealth may be hidden in Britain’s offshore havens.

cues.zh: 金融服务是英国精英的生财之道，
cues.en: Financial services is how Britain's elites make their money,

cues.zh: 也是前政府部长、高级公务员
cues.en: and it is also where former government ministers, senior civil servants

cues.zh: 以及 MI5 和 MI6 退役特工
cues.en: and retired spooks from MI5 and MI6

cues.zh: 在结束公职后获得高薪咨询职位的地方。
cues.en: receive lucrative consulting positions after their time in public service.

cues.zh: 他们共同把英国及其属地
cues.en: Together they have transformed Britain and its dependencies

cues.zh: 变成了世界最大的避税天堂，
cues.en: into the world's largest tax haven,

cues.zh: 损害了全球各地的发展，
cues.en: harming development throughout the world,

cues.zh: 也让英国自身
cues.en: and turning Britain itself,

cues.zh: 沦为一个首先服务于其精英利益的国家。
cues.en: into a country that serves above all the interests of its elites.
